notablePrerequisites: Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi Cave Guard's power.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scarecrone.
Repeat.
